audioScript:

Man: Fiona, structural strain gauges on three monopile towers in our Baltic offshore array recorded persistent lateral oscillation during yesterday’s crosswind swells. The fatigue load is approaching our design ceiling.
Woman: Are the blade-pitch control algorithms failing to dampen the sway, Mikkel?
Man: Pitch adjustments help during steady gusts, yet wave-induced resonance at low frequencies keeps exciting the tower base. The engineering team recommends retrofitting passive tuned mass dampers inside the upper transition nacelles.
